author: Saurav Dahal (Ginger)
review_text: I’m giving eSewa a one-star review because it’s been nothing but trouble. The servers crash way too often, leaving me stuck when I’m trying to pay a bill or send money. Customer service is a joke nobody picks up the phone,and the chat support is useless. Logging in is a nightmare, especially since my account is tied to, and even with my active linked SIM, the OTP either arrives way too late or doesn’t show up at all. The app freezes or glitches constantly, fix this all .
